title: Go: Conditionals
description: Use if, else, else if, and switch statements to control program flow.

steps.title: If Statement
steps.description: Set `age := 18` and write an `if` statement that prints `"Adult"` if age is 18 or more.
hints: No parentheses needed around the condition in Go.
The opening brace must be on the same line as if.

steps.title: If-Else
steps.description: Set `score := 45`. Print `"Pass"` if score >= 50, else print `"Fail"`.
hints: The else goes on the same line as the closing brace.
45 is less than 50, so it should print 'Fail'.

verification.failureMessage: Print 'Fail' when score (45) is less than 50.

steps.title: Else If Chain
steps.description: Set `num := 0`. Print `"Positive"`, `"Negative"`, or `"Zero"` using if, else if, and else.
hints: Since num is 0, it should print 'Zero'.

verification.failureMessage: Print 'Zero' for num = 0 using if, else if, else.

steps.title: Switch with Cases
steps.description: Set `day := 3` and use a `switch` to print the day name: 1=Monday, 2=Tuesday, 3=Wednesday.

verification.failureMessage: Print 'Wednesday' when day is 3 using switch.

steps.title: Switch with No Expression
steps.description: Set `score := 85` and use a switch with no expression (switch true) to print `"A"` for >=80, `"B"` for >=60, else `"C"`.
hints: A switch with no expression is like a clean if-else chain.

verification.failureMessage: Print 'A' for score 85 using switch with no expression.
